# data/ — generated outputs (do not edit by hand)

Generated outputs from the SEO/ASO scripts: rank history, GSC pulls, crawl snapshots, store listings, benchmarks. Mostly gitignored/regenerable. Everything here is WRITTEN BY SCRIPTS and most of it is gitignored/regenerable — never edit these files manually; re-run the producing script instead. Representative families below (dated snapshots follow the same naming).

| File | What it does | Typical command |
|---|---|---|
| [`aso-competitors-latest.json`](./aso-competitors-latest.json) | Latest app-store competitor analysis output. | — |
| [`aso-metadata-history.json`](./aso-metadata-history.json) | History of every store metadata change, for cadence enforcement. | — |
| [`backlinks-history.json`](./backlinks-history.json) | Backlink counts over time from the backlinks monitor. | — |
| [`crawl-snapshot-latest.json`](./crawl-snapshot-latest.json) | Latest full site crawl snapshot; paired crawl-diff files show what changed. | — |
| [`cwv-history.json`](./cwv-history.json) | Core Web Vitals measurements over time. | — |
| [`gsc-anomalies-latest.json`](./gsc-anomalies-latest.json) | Latest Search Console anomaly detection output (traffic drops/spikes). | — |
| [`gsc-top-pages-2026-05-29.json`](./gsc-top-pages-2026-05-29.json) | Dated Google Search Console top-pages snapshot (one file per pull). | — |
| [`play-listing-devicegpt-en-US.json`](./play-listing-devicegpt-en-US.json) | Cached Play Store listing for one app (one file per package/locale). | — |
| [`rank-history.json`](./rank-history.json) | Time series of keyword rank positions from the rank tracker. | — |
| [`rank-watchlist.json`](./rank-watchlist.json) | Keywords currently being watched by the rank tracker. | — |
| [`rpm-benchmarks.json`](./rpm-benchmarks.json) | Ad RPM benchmark data (with AdMob and Reddit crowd-sourced variants). | — |
| [`seo-latest-report.txt`](./seo-latest-report.txt) | Most recent combined SEO monitoring text report. | — |
| [`seo-logs`](./seo-logs) | Daily and weekly run logs from the SEO monitoring scripts. | — |
